page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr5s.24xlarge is a memory-optimized bare-metal server belonging to the ECS Bare Metal family. The system is driven by dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. Across its 96 dedicated vCPUs, the instance delivers 768.0 GB of system memory, providing an 8.0 GB per-core memory footprint that accommodates large enterprise workloads without virtualization overhead.

Hardware configurations exclude integrated local disks, requiring storage configurations to interface via external cloud or network volumes. Baseline network throughput is provisioned at 32 Gbps, supporting significant data throughput across distributed nodes. The server features no GPU accelerators and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, operating under the KVM management framework within Alibaba Cloud infrastructure.

Given its 1:8 core-to-memory ratio, the instance prioritizes memory density over local storage capabilities. The dedicated core model and high RAM allocation yield strong cost efficiency for platforms that demand extensive addressable RAM footprints and predictable core performance. The architecture suits large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching systems, distributed analytics engines, and enterprise resource planning software.
